source_instruction: i am looking for a  counter height size barstools of faux leather
query:
Hey, I swear my cat’s been on a total chaos spree this entire week that’s thrown every little part of my routine totally off kilter. First, he figured out how to pry open the lid of the snack bin I keep on the kitchen counter, so I walked in Tuesday to half a bag of freeze-dried tuna treats crunched all over the floor and him passed out on the rug like he’d just pulled off the heist of the century. Then last night, he decided my favorite knit throw blanket was the perfect new spot to knead and shed all over right before I had a friend over for movie night, so I spent 20 minutes running the lint roller over it like a maniac while my friend laughed at me from the couch. He even batted one of my houseplant’s baby leaves off right before I sat down to pull up your website just now, the little stinker.
I’m browsing the bar stools section right now and need a little help picking something out. I’m looking for stools made of bonded leather, and I want that one height style I always go for for my kitchen island, y’know? I don’t want to spend too much, so just keep the total under what I usually set as my cap for small furniture pieces, yeah? Let me know what options you have that fit what I’m after, thanks!
